options: all existing preprocessing/search options enabled; only fused_local_search differs between fallback and fused
sanity: one final fused_requested_float call per image, integer_local_max=false; current dispatch uses the original float path; excluded from raw timings
order: rotate three cases by image and round, reverse on alternate rounds
cold_scope: fresh current workspaces and reset V4 workspace per image; not a fresh process or hardware cache
comparison: full exact class/x/y/float-bits semantic sets, template-id strict sets, and raw counts against each image's V4 cold output; any mismatch fails
primary_measure: internal search_ms and api_total_ms; V4 external wall includes adapter conversion
